mechanism: Evolving episodic case memory refined during deployment with contextual-bandit case selection
evidence_scope: We present CASCADE (CASe-based Continual Adaptation during DEployment), a general and principled framework that equips LLM agents with an explicit, evolving episodic memory.
evidence_role: We present CASCADE (CASe-based Continual Adaptation during DEployment), a general and principled framework that equips LLM agents with an explicit, evolving episodic memory.
